hero_kpi_rationale: The NIM is a key indicator of the company's financial performance, reflecting its ability to generate net interest income and the efficiency of its asset and liability management.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Margin between interest income and interest expenses
kpis.description: The net interest margin is a key indicator of the company's financial performance

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: The company's total revenue for the fourth fiscal quarter

kpis.name: Total Gross Loans and Leases
kpis.explanation: Total gross loans and leases of the company
kpis.description: Total gross loans and leases represent the company's total credit portfolio
kpis.signal: Increase in total gross loans and leases

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: The company's total assets decreased primarily due to reductions in loans held for investment and available-for-sale securities

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.description: Total deposits represent customer funds held by the company

kpis.name: Stockholders' Equity
kpis.description: Stockholders' equity increased primarily due to increases in additional paid-in capital and retained earnings

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.04 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.12 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Dividends + buybacks cumulative (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income redistributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
